title: Rabbi Elazar ben Yirmeyah

paragraphs: (A Tanna of a baraita.) He is mentioned in [Sotah 4a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.4a.3) on the measure of seclusion; he holds that it is the time needed for a weaver to tie a thread. Hyman reports that [the Epistle of Rav Sherira Gaon](https://www.sefaria.org/Epistle_of_Rav_Sherira_Gaon.1.12), part 1, chapter 2, places him in the generation of Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara gives Rabbi Elazar ben Yirmeyah and the weaver’s thread. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=526&lang=en) cites the folio and also reports Rav Sherira’s placement. In the linked digital Epistle, the list naming Elazar immediately follows [the paragraph on Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel’s generation](https://www.sefaria.org/Epistle_of_Rav_Sherira_Gaon.1.11).
